pages.title: About PartnerOnRent
pages.content: PartnerOnRent is India's pioneer platonic companion ecosystem connecting urban professionals, travelers, and seniors with verified local partners for movies, cafes, family events, and wellness talks.

pages.title: Trust, Safety & Zero-Tolerance Protocols
pages.content: All companions undergo government ID checks (Aadhaar & PAN) with live biometric matching. All bookings must take place in public venues with one-tap emergency SOS dispatch.

items.q: Is this a dating or escort service?
items.a: No. PartnerOnRent is strictly a platonic companionship platform for social company, events, travel, and emotional wellness. Any misconduct leads to an instant ban and legal reporting.
Every partner undergoes mandatory Aadhaar/Govt ID verification, criminal background screening, and video interview verification.
Cancellations made >24 hours in advance receive a 100% refund. 12-24 hours receive 75% refund.
